biography.value:
Jin Dahaad

Gargantuan leviathan, unaligned — Challenge 16 (Amellwind Hunt Boss)

Ice-cliff apex predator. Place the token, set Hunters Quantity, Deploy Armored Plates, and run the four-phase hunt (~8 rounds at 4 hunters).

Combat notes

  • Hunters Quantity: body 480 / plates 40 at 1–3; ×1.5 / ×2 / ×2.5 at 4 / 5 / 6.
  • Plates: four tokens (AC 20). Break → AC −1 + scaled body HP loss. Head only after Bite. Back elevated.
  • Phases: auto at 75% / 50% / 25% HP (or Phase Shift). Phase 4 readies Subzero.
  • Recharge ice: Frost Breath (5–6), Frost Mist (5–6), Flash Freeze (6), Subzero Shockwave (6).
  • Native first: attacks chain Midi other activities (Iceblight / Prone); frost saves apply Restrained AE; Body Slam / Charge apply Prone; Subzero Charge applies self AE. Item Macro only for canvas tokens, hunters HP, phases, ice blocks, pushes / pulls, Claw cold splash, and Amellwind blight riders.
biography.public: A gargantuan ice-cliff leviathan hunt boss.

description.value:
Jin Dahaad's body is covered in four sets of armored plates (Legs/Claws, Tail, Back, Head). Each plate can be attacked and destroyed (AC 20; HP scales with Hunters Quantity, base 40 at 3 hunters; immunity to poison and psychic).

  • Back plate sits at elevation (not reachable from the ground without climb/fly/ranged).
  • Head plate is only damageable from the ground on rounds when Jin Dahaad makes a Bite attack.
  • For each plate destroyed, Jin Dahaad loses scaled hit points (base 10 × hunter mult) and its AC is reduced by 1.

Use Deploy Armored Plates to place plate tokens on the canvas.
description.chat: Four plates (AC 20, scaled HP). Destroy: AC −1 + scaled body HP loss.

description.value: Legendary Resistance (2/Day). If Jin Dahaad fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Amellwind solo-boss HP scaling (same multipliers as Tempered Alatreon):

  • 1–3 hunters: max HP × 1 (480 body; 40 per plate)
  • 4 hunters: × 1.5 (720 / 60)
  • 5 hunters: × 2 (960 / 80)
  • 6 hunters: × 2.5 (1200 / 100)

Plate-break body HP loss also scales (10 × mult). Set hunters once after placing the token.

macro.name: Hunters Quantity

description.value:
Places four plate tokens on the current scene (Legs/Claws, Tail, Back at 15 ft, Head at 5 ft). Attack the tokens directly. HP scales with Hunters Quantity.

Use Clear Plate Tokens to remove them before redeploying after a Phase Shift.
description.chat: Spawn / clear the four armored plate tokens.

macro.name: Deploy Armored Plates

description.value:
Jin Dahaad hunts across four areas (~2 rounds each at 4 hunters). Phases also advance automatically at 75% / 50% / 25% body HP.

  1. Cliff Approach — melee pressure, deploy plates
  2. Frozen Basin — Breath / Mist; first Subzero window
  3. Vertical Spire — climb play, Flash Freeze, head/back plates
  4. Rime Crater (Absolute Zero) — Subzero is ready on entry

Manual buttons force a phase (and whisper the area change). Redeploy unbroken plates after relocating.
description.chat: Advance or set hunt phase (1–4). Phase 4 readies Subzero.

macro.name: Phase Shift

description.value: Jin Dahaad makes one Bite or Claw attack and one Kick or Tail attack.

Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (4d8 + 7) piercing + 4 (1d8) cold. The target must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or be afflicted with iceblight for 1 minute.

Native Midi: on-hit other activity (save + Iceblight AE). Using Bite applies Head Plate Exposed to Jin Dahaad until the start of its next turn.
description.chat: +12, 15 ft. 4d8+7 piercing + 1d8 cold; DC 21 Con or iceblight. Unlocks Head Plate.

effects.name: Iceblight
effects.description: No reactions; speed halved; can't make more than one attack on your turn. Repeat the DC 21 Constitution save at the end of each of your turns, ending the effect on a success.

effects.name: Head Plate Exposed
effects.description: Jin Dahaad's Head Plate can be targeted until the start of its next turn.

description.value:
Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) slashing + 7 (2d6) cold. Each creature within 5 feet of the target takes damage equal to the cold damage dealt.

Module: on hit, the rolled cold damage is applied to every other creature within 5 ft of the target (resistance / immunity respected).
description.chat: +12, 10 ft. 2d6+7 slashing + 2d6 cold (splash cold to adjacent).

macro.name: Claw

description.value:
Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) bludgeoning. Target must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

Native Midi: on-hit other activity (Str save + Prone AE).
description.chat: +12, 5 ft. 2d8+7 bludgeoning; DC 20 Str or prone.

description.value: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) slashing.

Jin Dahaad slams its body on the ground in its space. Each creature on the ground within 30 feet must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw. Failed: 9 (2d10) bludgeoning + 14 (4d6) cold, pushed 10 feet, knocked prone. Success: half damage, no push/prone.

Native: Prone AE on a failed save. Module: pushes failed creatures 10 ft away (GM is whispered when a wall blocks the push).
description.chat: 30 ft: DC 20 Dex, 2d10 bludgeoning + 4d6 cold, push/prone.

macro.name: Body Slam

description.value:
Recharge 5–6. Exhales ice and snow in a 45-foot cone or a 90-foot line that is 10 feet wide. DC 21 Constitution save: 45 (10d8) cold on a failed save, or half on a success. If the save fails by 5 or more, the creature is restrained by ice.

Native: Midi save activity — pick Cone or Line (damage respects resistance / immunity / vulnerability). Module: fail by 5+ applies Restrained (Ice) and spawns an Ice Block token (AC 18 / 20 HP; vulnerable to fire).
description.chat: Recharge 5–6. Cone 45 or line 90×10: DC 21 Con, 10d8 cold; fail by 5+ ice block.

effects.name: Restrained (Ice)
effects.description: Restrained by ice. Destroy the linked Ice Block token (AC 18; 20 HP; vulnerable to fire) or succeed on Str DC 18 to break free.

macro.name: Frost Breath

description.value:
Recharge 5–6. Freezing mist within 10 feet on the ground. DC 21 Strength save or restrained by ice.

Native: Midi save + Restrained AE on fail. Module: Ice Block token (AC 18 / 20 HP; vulnerable to fire).
description.chat: Recharge 5–6. 10 ft: DC 21 Str or restrained + ice block.

effects.name: Restrained (Ice)
effects.description: Restrained by ice. Destroy the linked Ice Block token (AC 18; 20 HP; vulnerable to fire) or succeed on Str DC 18 to break free.

macro.name: Frost Mist

description.value:
Recharge 6. Freezes the ground in a 60-foot radius. DC 21 Strength save or take 14 (4d6) cold and become restrained by ice.

Native: Midi save (cold respects traits) + Restrained AE. Module: Ice Block token.
description.chat: Recharge 6. 60 ft: DC 21 Str, 4d6 cold + ice block.

effects.name: Restrained (Ice)
effects.description: Restrained by ice. Destroy the linked Ice Block token (AC 18; 20 HP; vulnerable to fire) or succeed on Str DC 18 to break free.

macro.name: Flash Freeze

description.value:
Ultimate — Recharge 6. Automatically ready when Jin Dahaad enters Phase 4.

Charge: Ice walls rise; creatures within 5 ft are pushed 5 ft away. Native AE until the start of Jin Dahaad's next turn: speed 0, no legendary actions. Module: wind-pressure saves (player Adv/Disadv dialogs); at the start of its next turn the charge ends and the GM is prompted to Detonate.

Detonate: Native Midi save — 33 (6d10) piercing + 44 (8d10) cold (traits respected). Module: fail → Iceblight; fail by 5+ → Frozen + ice shell.
description.chat: Recharge 6 ultimate. Charge (native AE) then Detonate (Midi save + module riders).

effects.name: Subzero Shockwave — Charging
effects.description: Speed 0; no legendary actions; total cover from outside the ice walls until detonation.

macro.name: Subzero Shockwave

description.value:
Jin Dahaad makes one Claw attack or Kick attack.

Native: Kick chains to a Str save + Prone AE (other activity). Module: Claw cold splash (same as Claw).

macro.name: Legendary: Attack

description.value:
Jin Dahaad moves 10 feet toward a target and makes one Bite attack against it.

Native Midi: other activity Iceblight save + Head Plate Exposed AE (same as Bite).

effects.name: Iceblight
effects.description: No reactions; speed halved; can't make more than one attack on your turn. Repeat the DC 21 Constitution save at the end of each of your turns, ending the effect on a success.

effects.name: Head Plate Exposed
effects.description: Jin Dahaad's Head Plate can be targeted until the start of its next turn.

description.value:
Costs 2 legendary actions. Jin Dahaad moves up to its speed through creatures' spaces without opportunity attacks. Each creature it moves through must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity save or take 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning, be pushed 15 feet, and knocked prone.

Use: move the token, target the creatures it passed through, then use Charge. Native: Prone AE on a failed save. Module: pushes failed creatures 15 ft away from Jin Dahaad.
description.chat: Legendary ×2: move through creatures; DC 20 Dex or 3d8+7, push 15, prone.

macro.name: Legendary: Charge
